WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', stat_period_start) AS metric_time__day
    , DATE_TRUNC('month', stat_period_start) AS metric_time__month
    , member_id AS __monthly_buyer_count
    , CASE WHEN member_month_valid_order_count >= 2 THEN member_id END AS __monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."valid_order_month_facts" valid_order_month_facts_src_10000
)

SELECT
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month) AS metric_time__month
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_8.monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(CAST(subq_14.monthly_repeat_buyer_count AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(subq_14.monthly_buyer_count, 0) AS DOUBLE)) AS monthly_repeat_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_8
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    metric_time__month
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_repeat_buyer_count
    , COUNT(DISTINCT __monthly_buyer_count) AS monthly_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY
    metric_time__month
) subq_14
ON
  subq_8.metric_time__month = subq_14.metric_time__month
GROUP BY
  COALESCE(subq_8.metric_time__month, subq_14.metric_time__month)

青禾在 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的会员购买与复购情况如下（统计单位为 CRM 会员账户，均为完整自然月、全门店口径，两个月分别独立统计，不能将人数相加为跨月人数）：

- 2026 年 7 月：月内购买会员数 16,436 户；月内复购会员数 7,388 户；月内复购率 44.95%。
- 2026 年 8 月：月内购买会员数 16,504 户；月内复购会员数 7,302 户；月内复购率 44.24%。

口径说明：月内购买会员数为同一自然月有至少一笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购会员数为同一自然月有至少两笔有效订单的账户数；月内复购率=月内复购会员数÷月内购买会员数。
question: 青禾 2026 年 7 月和 8 月的月内购买会员数、月内复购会员数和月内复购率，按月分别列出。
